content.prompt:
Write the following descriptions in set notation, utilising $\cup$ and/or $\cap$ symbols. Some can be listed, whilst others you can try.

Real numbers except $1$ and $-1$.

answer.worked:
Split the real line at the two excluded values. All finite endpoints are open:
$$(-\infty,-1)\cup(-1,1)\cup(1,\infty).$$
